in_sanskrit.name: हरिराम
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The son of Hari (Vishnu), who removes all sorrows.

in_marathi.name: Hariram
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Hari (God Vishnu) + Ram (God Rama)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hariram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hariram is a combination of two popular Hindu deity names, Hari and Ram. Hari refers to Lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe, while Ram signifies Lord Rama, an avatar of Vishnu known for his righteousness and courage. Therefore, Hariram is a name that symbolizes the divine qualities of both these deities.
